topology_reasoning: Two waveguides with S-bend approaches. Left side: waveguides separated vertically (~1.7 µm total height, so each waveguide ~0.4µm with ~0.5µm gap at edges). They converge via S-bends toward center, run parallel with minimal gap (coupling region), then diverge via S-bends on right. The coupling length and gap determine the power splitting ratio. Function-defining knobs: (1) waveguide width, (2) coupling gap, (3) coupling length, (4) S-bend length/radius, (5) input/output separation.
